semantic_review.bgmv_expand_slice: Four complete raw original/existing output-first candidate bodies cover both accepted signed metadata ABIs. Original Python JIT/wrapper, Correct/FPEquiv/Contract and host input restrictions are byte-identical. The 13 top-level Python AST nodes include the retained docstring. All int64 casts, sentinel early return, EVEN_K load alternatives, signed tl.cdiv, CAST_TYPE branch, signed N loop, actual masks, half multiply/sum, optional old-output addition and final store remain in the quotation. Dtypes, exact contiguous runtime strides and constexpr bindings are outside it. The candidate only exchanges the final FP32 addition operands. The proof-only constexpr view is connected to the complete raw body by full-state/failure equality and trace-safety equivalence for arbitrary opaque algebras; both metadata ABIs have complete-kernel equality. The ordered IO value formula removes the fabricated same-format FP32 cast after addition, while retaining the genuine half-to-FP32 widening and all geometry/channels. New independent SourceValues/SourceGrid support actual signed execution, exact full-grid output and exterior frame, access safety, Real dense-sum correctness, native/host/Tensor results and full-state/failure/safety-preserving FP equivalence. Original nonempty and empty-grid cases and broader backed abstract scope remain. No opaque FP cast identity, new axiom, whole-kernel/model premise, domain narrowing or numerical experiment is introduced.
